assertions.subject: Epidermoid cysts
assertions.quote: Epidermoid cysts (often mistakenly referred to as sebaceous cysts) are classically the result of keratin-plugged pilosebaceous units

assertions.subject: Epidermoid cysts
assertions.quote: Epi-dermoid cysts are histologically characterized by mature epidermis complete with granular layer

assertions.subject: Trichilemmal cysts
assertions.quote: They are derived from the outer sheath of hair follicles, and, in contrast to epidermoid cysts, lack a granular layer

assertions.subject: Dermoid cysts
assertions.quote: Dermoid cysts are congenital variants that occur as the result of persistent epithelium within embry-onic lines of fusion

assertions.subject: Dermoid cysts
assertions.quote: These cystic structures contain epithelial tissue, hair, and a variety of epidermal appendages

assertions.subject: Dermoid cysts
assertions.quote: They can lie in the subcutaneous tissue or intracranially, and often communicate with the skin surface via a small fis-tula

assertions.subject: Actinic keratoses
assertions.quote: UV radiation exposure is the greatest risk factor

assertions.subject: Actinic keratoses
assertions.quote: They can present as erythematous and scaly to hypertrophic, keratinized lesions

assertions.subject: Actinic keratoses
assertions.quote: It is estimated that approximately 10% of actinic keratoses will transform into invasive squamous cell carcinoma
